{"code": "rows_5n = get_rows('Source data figure 5.xlsx', '5n')
rows_5o = get_rows('Source data figure 5.xlsx', '5o')
pid = [r[0] for r in rows_5n[2:]]
vopt = {r[0]: (r[4]+r[5]+r[6])/3 for r in rows_5n[2:]}
topt = {r[0]: (r[4]+r[5]+r[6])/3 for r in rows_5o[2:]}
cv, ct = 48.97, 50.47
truth_res = ['P11','P12','P13','P14','P32','P34','P35','P36','P37','P38','P39']
for name, rule in [('AND', lambda p: vopt[p]>cv and topt[p]>ct),
                   ('OR',  lambda p: vopt[p]>cv or topt[p]>ct),
                   ('V-only', lambda p: vopt[p]>cv),
                   ('T-only', lambda p: topt[p]>ct)]:
    pred = [p for p in pid if rule(p)]
    TP = len(set(pred)&set(truth_res)); FP = len(set(pred)-set(truth_res))
    TN = 11-FP; FN = 11-TP
    print(name, 'pred_n', len(pred), 'sens %.4f spec %.4f acc %.4f' % (TP/11, TN/11, (TP+TN)/22))
# also min-based score with single cutoff search
import itertools
score = {p: min(vopt[p], topt[p]) for p in pid}
best=None
for c in sorted(set(score.values())):
    pred=[p for p in pid if score[p]>c]
    TP=len(set(pred)&set(truth_res)); FP=len(set(pred)-set(truth_res)); TN=11-FP
    acc=(TP+TN)/22
    if best is None or acc>best[1]: best=(c,acc,TP/11,TN/11)
print('min-score best cutoff', best)
